field_semantics.claim_boundary: MUST say fixture/mock only and MUST NOT imply production readiness.
field_semantics.api_surface: One of public or internal; public uses the request-time header model, internal mesh uses /vN URL/package major-version selection.
field_semantics.provisional_schema_subject: A placeholder following the current Apicurio subject convention <schema-kind>.<microservice>.<surface>.<event-class-or-resource>; API-001 must replace or ratify it before registry publication.
field_semantics.schema_revision: SemVer for fixture/object shape evolution; breaking fixture shape changes require a major bump and deprecation-handshake note even before runtime exists.
field_semantics.public_api_generation: A mock YYYY-MM-DD generation value may appear in fixture transcripts only when public_api_generation_is_mock is true; it is not a minted production generation.
field_semantics.tenant_scope: Must include organization_id, account_id, project_id, region, and cell when modeling cloud/control-plane resources.
field_semantics.response_headers: For public API fixture transcripts, include X-Oyatie-API-Version, X-Oyatie-Default-Version, X-Oyatie-Latest-Version and optional Sunset/Deprecation placeholders.

versioning: Public fixture APIs model ADR-0258 request-time pinning with X-Oyatie-API-Version; header absence is represented as default_public_version resolution, not as no-version behavior.
Internal fixture APIs model ADR-0258 mesh routing with /v1/ URL path or v1 package names; minor/patch changes stay schema/subject semver and do not change the URL.
Every fixture transcript that shows a deprecated generation must include Deprecation/Sunset placeholders and a migration/evidence link, but it must remain marked mock-only.
schema_registry: Fixture subjects are provisional and follow the shape <schema-kind>.<microservice>.<surface>.<event-class-or-resource> until API-001 ratifies exact microservice/surface/resource tokens.
Default compatibility assumptions: BACKWARD for events and REST responses, FORWARD for REST requests, FULL for ontology/audit-chain, NONE only with explicit ADR carve-out.
Fixture schemas may be JSON Schema evidence records now; production REST/gRPC/GraphQL/AsyncAPI artifacts remain API-001 output.
surface_separation: Public fixture routes use api_surface=public, hostname=api.oyatie.com, auth=oauth2-plus-key-signature, rate_limit_tier=per-public-key-per-ip, semver_discipline=mandatory.
Internal fixture routes use api_surface=internal, hostname=internal-api.oyatie.com, auth=mesh-mtls-spiffe-only, rate_limit_tier=per-microservice-internal, semver_discipline=optional.
security_and_privacy: Every fixture that crosses tenant/account/project boundaries must include a cross-tenant denial or zero-result case.
Cedar/default-deny is represented by policy decision fixtures only; no runtime policy evaluator is claimed.
Support/admin views must show redaction behavior and must not leak another tenant resource's existence through filters or aggregates.
No raw secrets, raw provider internals, credential values, or real customer invoice rows may appear in fixtures.
design_system: Use existing component contracts where possible: tenant-context-switcher, entity-action-policy-preview, audit-evidence-timeline, cloud-cell-topology-map, ops-deployment-status-panel, score-card-result-table, spec-diff-viewer, policy-disclosure-banner.
Fixture UX must preserve catalog principles: WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard-first, precise operational copy, skeleton/progressive loading, and visible error/remediation states.
